items.label: Confirmed
items.headline: ₹20 per 10,000 characters: Sarvam's Bulbul V4 Flash cuts text to speech cost by a third
items.what: Sarvam launched Bulbul V4 Flash, a smaller text to speech model for Indian languages with under 250 ms to first audio in production, priced at ₹20 per 10,000 characters against ₹30 for Bulbul V3.
items.why: Real-time voice agents in Indian languages, like the rail helpline demo Sarvam shows, now get more expressive speech at a third less cost per character.
items.move: Rerun your voice bot's latency and cost test on Bulbul V4 Flash this week and compare cost per call with your current text to speech vendor.
items.post: Sarvam's Bulbul V4 Flash: Indian language text to speech at ₹20 per 10,000 characters, a third cheaper than V3, with under 250 ms to first audio.

items.label: Early signal
items.headline: 20% lower: Anthropic's Managed Agents cost example now uses cheaper token rates
items.what: Anthropic's pricing page example for Claude Managed Agents now uses $4 (₹381) input and $20 (₹1,906) output per million tokens, down from $5 (₹477) and $25 (₹2,383), with no announcement and no model named in the change.
items.why: For Indian teams budgeting Claude agent sessions in rupees, the token rates in the official example are now 20% lower, so per-session cost assumptions deserve a second look.
items.move: Check which Claude model your agents run on against the current pricing table and recompute your cost per session before your next margin review.
items.post: Anthropic's Managed Agents cost example now uses token rates 20% lower than the day before. Worth rechecking your agent cost per session.

items.label: Confirmed
items.headline: Sarvam ships Instant Voice Cloning (beta) in its Python and TypeScript SDKs
items.what: Sarvam's API changelog for 12 October shows Instant Voice Cloning in beta in the sarvamai SDKs (Python 0.1.37 or later, TypeScript 1.1.12 or later), with one-shot, HTTP streaming and WebSocket calls.
items.why: Voice cloning from an Indian provider now follows the same call shape as Bulbul text to speech, so teams already on Sarvam can add it without new plumbing; language coverage is not stated yet.
items.move: Upgrade to sarvamai 0.1.37, request the text_to_speech_voice_cloning capability, and test a cloned brand voice over the WebSocket stream in your support bot this week.
items.post: Sarvam added Instant Voice Cloning (beta) to its Python and TypeScript SDKs, with HTTP and WebSocket streaming and the same call shape as Bulbul TTS.
